name: Summon & Warp Probe (research)
description: Research only, no gameplay effect. Warp: wear a LIFT-182 Warp Pack and warp a few times; the log shows the checks the game runs before it moves you (its raycasts, their timing) and the warp's own code. Summon: logs the code of the game's entity spawn and the engine's unit functions, and every 10 s the nearest enemies (type, distance), for a summoned mech the mod drives itself. Turn off when done.
